englishName: Ruler of the Black Flame Deck Build Box

description.text: Ruler of the Black Flame Deck Build Box, released on 11 August 2023 with the Ruler of the Black Flame expansion: ten packs of the expansion, a fixed 170 cards (38 kinds, 66 cards, among them Radiant Greninja, Lumineon V and Iono, and 104 basic Energy), a card box with four dividers and a VSTAR marker. Some cards are reprints from the Sword & Shield series, a few in a different look from the first print.
